title: Expiring One-Word Domains: a sample of 1,000 names with status and prices
description:
1,000 one-word domain names close to their expiry date, each with the day its registration ends, its status, prices when known, two coarse bands, the word's length and a registrar. If the owner does not renew, the word may come back on that ending, once.

The files are expiring.csv and expiring.json. The GitHub repository refreshes them every night, and this record holds them as they were on the day of its release, so a study of renewals can be reproduced and cited. The list of the day is at https://unique.domains/domains/expiring.

The Unique.domains API serves the list at GET https://api.unique.domains/v1/domains/expiring, an operation that needs a key. Documentation: https://unique.domains/api.
